tableQueries.label: Attività mese precedente
tableQueries.queryString: select csn.id_cons, csn.codice_compito, substring(entrasp.descrizione_consuntivazione(csn.codice_azienda, csn.id_cons), 1, 200) as titolo_compito,csn.data_intervento, csn.date_time_begin::timestamp with time zone,csn.date_time_end::timestamp with time zone,  csn.durata, csn.durata_ft, entrasp.anagrafiche_id_codcognnome(csn.codice_part, csn.id_risorsa) as esecutore, substring(csn.note from 1 for 100) as note_restricted, csn.codice_azienda from entrasp.consuntivazioni csn inner join entrasp.aziende az on csn.codice_azienda=az.codice_azienda WHERE csn.codice_azienda in(€global_user_companies€) and entrasp.dynamo_user_from_id_an(csn.codice_part, csn.id_risorsa)='€global_username€' and csn.data_intervento between entrasp.first_last_day_period('month', 'previous', 'first') and entrasp.first_last_day_period('month', 'previous', 'last') order by date_time_begin asc;

tableQueries.label: Giornalieri mese precedente
tableQueries.queryString: select csn.data_intervento, sum(csn.durata) as minuti, round(sum(csn.durata)/60 ,2) as ore,( SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM csn.data_intervento) ) as giorno_settimana from entrasp.consuntivazioni csn inner join entrasp.aziende az on csn.codice_azienda=az.codice_azienda WHERE csn.codice_azienda in(€global_user_companies€) and entrasp.dynamo_user_from_id_an(csn.codice_part, csn.id_risorsa)='€global_username€'::text and data_intervento between entrasp.first_last_day_period('month', 'previous', 'first') and entrasp.first_last_day_period('month', 'previous', 'last') GROUP BY data_intervento order by data_intervento asc;

tableQueries.label: Totale mese precedente
tableQueries.queryString: select sum(csn.durata) as minuti_totali_mensili, ROUND(sum(csn.durata)/60.00, 2) as ore_totali_mensili from entrasp.consuntivazioni csn inner join entrasp.aziende az on csn.codice_azienda=az.codice_azienda WHERE csn.codice_azienda in(€global_user_companies€) and entrasp.dynamo_user_from_id_an(csn.codice_part, csn.id_risorsa)='€global_username€' AND ( SELECT DATE_PART('year', data_intervento) ) = (select case when extract(month from current_date)-1 = 0 then extract(year from current_date)-1 else extract(year from current_date) end) and ( SELECT DATE_PART('month', data_intervento)) = (select case when extract(month from current_date)-1 = 0 then 12 else extract(month from current_date)-1 end);
